commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Loki, the Deceiver ({1}{U}{B}{R} legendary God Sorcerer Villain 4/4; Marvel Super Heroes Commander, msc, released 2026-06-26; oracle_id 17e45fd8-c924-4b42-87ad-189469a8dd18). Commander-legal per live Scryfall, not a Game Changer, released, no project exception. Oracle: whenever Loki attacks, create a tapped and attacking token copy of another target Villain you control, except it isn't legendary and is an Illusion; sacrifice it at the next end step. Whenever one or more Villains you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card. Plan (owner 2026-10-14): attack safely with Loki (Swiftfoot Boots, Lightning Greaves), copy the best enters/static/combat-damage Villain (attack triggers do not fire on the copy, CR 508.4), keep tokens with The Master, Multiplied or Sundial of the Infinite, double triggers with Roaming Throne naming Villain, and draw on connection. Both adds are enters-trigger Villains chosen for exactly that rule.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized; owner-approved, registry ceiling 4), unchanged. Game Changers: 5 in both baseline and candidate (Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Jeska's Will, Rhystic Study), so Bracket 3 is impossible; the GrokBot advisory's 'B3 with 5 Game Changers' wording is an inconsistency Pass C flagged, corrected here. Commander Spellbook: 0 included combos in baseline, candidate and all alternatives; no infinite combo is added.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Loki's Oracle: both adds are Villains whose enters triggers repeat on every Loki token copy, replacing Villains whose copies lose their attack triggers. No generic combo (Thassa's Oracle / Demonic Consultation, fast-combo or sacrifice-loop packages), no additional clone effect, no Plan and no owner-removed card (Construct a Cosmic Cube, The Masters of Evil, Reliquary Tower) or owner-rejected card or class (Kindred Dominance, Raise the Palisade, Endless Ranks of HYDRA, attack-trigger-centric Villains such as Puppet Master, String Puller and Vulture, Scheming Scavenger) is added. The owner's own 2026-10-14 reason for rejecting attack-trigger Villains (a Loki copy enters attacking and does not retrigger attack abilities) is the same rule that makes both cuts weak Loki targets. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the registry Archidekt exports, candidate/baseline, of 92 nonbasic names): Doctor Doom, King of Latveria 53/53 (the closest Grixis Villain deck); Be'lakor, the Dark Master 42/42; Admiral Brass, Unsinkable 40/40; Nathan Drake, Treasure Hunter 40/40. The overlap is the Grixis mana base and staples plus the Marvel Villain core shared with Doctor Doom. Loki-unique against all four in the candidate (24 names): Avengers: Under Siege; Carnage, Crimson Chaos; Cover of Darkness; Crossbones, Malicious Mercenary; Doctor Octopus, Master Planner; Elektra, Daughter of the Hand; Hall of Echoes; Kang Prime; Loki's Scepter; Loki, God of Mischief; Loki, Lord of Misrule; Madame Hydra; Mysterio, Master of Illusion; Patchwork Banner; Red Ghost, Intangible Genius; Stilt-Man, Towering Terror; Sundial of the Infinite; Taskmaster, Mercenary Mimic; The Master, Multiplied; The Squadron Sinister; Thunderbolts Conspiracy; Titan of Littjara; Ultimo, Civilization's End; Venom, Eddie Brock. The swaps leave overlap with every compared deck unchanged: neither cut nor either add appears in any of the four (or in any other registry export).

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 library cards were reviewed (91 single rows plus 3 Island, 3 Swamp, 2 Mountain; 95 distinct names). Owner 2026-10-14 adds: Red Ghost, Intangible Genius; Titan of Littjara; Hall of Echoes (replacing Construct a Cosmic Cube, The Masters of Evil, Reliquary Tower). Neither cut (Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil; Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper) is an owner add or explicit keep. Candidate roles: 34 lands; 29 Villain cards including Loki (Ultimo and Elektra replace two Villains); clone suite Spark Double, Taskmaster, Chameleon, Loki, Lord of Misrule, Hall of Echoes; Villain token makers Mysterio, Madame Hydra, Black Market Connections; token keepers The Master, Multiplied and Sundial of the Infinite; trigger doubler Roaming Throne; cost reducers Baron Strucker, Tombstone, Urza's Incubator; protection Swiftfoot Boots, Lightning Greaves, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Mana Drain; removal Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, Deadly Rollick, Vandalblast, plus Ultimo and Elektra triggers; card flow Rhystic Study, Kindred Discovery, Black Market Connections, Loki's draw.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 34 lands unchanged (basics 3 Island, 3 Swamp, 2 Mountain). 65 nonland cards plus Loki; curve MV1 5, MV2 15, MV3 18 -> 16, MV4 17 -> 18, MV5 4, MV6 4 -> 5, MV7 2, MV9 1; average nonland MV 3.394 -> 3.455; coloured pips U/B/R (all mana costs including Loki and both faces of Norman Osborn // Green Goblin) 29/36/17 -> 29/39/16, library front faces only 27/34/15 -> 27/37/14; coloured land sources U/B/R 21/20/20 unchanged. Bounded goldfish (seed 28, 20000 games): P(Loki on battlefield by turn 4) 0.6242 -> 0.6195; P(Loki attacks with a valid Villain target) turn 4 0.1803 -> 0.1682, turn 5 0.5849 -> 0.5696; P(MV<=3 Villain by turn 3) 0.3005 -> 0.2567. That is the real cost of the two swaps.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deflecting Swat. Board: Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, Deadly Rollick, Vandalblast, Otawara. The baseline was thin on repeatable creature removal; the candidate adds an each-opponent edict and a power-3-or-less destroy on every Loki copy. Weak to graveyard-independent sweepers and to losing Loki; Boots and Greaves remain.

material_candidates.role: {4}{B}{B} 6/5 menace artifact Villain: when it enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice; {2}{B}, discard it: each opponent sacrifices a creature.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil is not an owner addition or explicit keep. {2}{B} 1/3: whenever one or more nontoken Villains you control attack a player, create a 2/1 black Villain token with menace. As a Loki copy target it does nothing: the token is not nontoken and was never declared as an attacker (CR 508.4), so the copy adds only a 1/3 body. EDHREC general 862/2281, optimized 5/25. Competing cut staged: Kang Prime (stronger incumbent by adoption).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Every Loki attack can copy Ultimo, so each attack makes each opponent sacrifice a creature (twice with Roaming Throne naming Villain), getting around hexproof, ward and indestructible; the menace 6/5 copy tends to connect for Loki's card draw. The discard mode is an instant-speed edict when it cannot be cast. Baron Strucker, HYDRA Overlord, Tombstone, Career Criminal and Urza's Incubator reduce its cost; Spark Double, Chameleon, Master of Disguise and Taskmaster, Mercenary Mimic can copy it too.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Six mana where Crimson Cowl costs three: P(MV<=3 Villain deployed by turn 3) 0.3005 -> 0.2834 for this swap alone; opponents choose the sacrificed creature, so it hits their worst body. Popularity is mildly against it: 131/2281 Loki decks and absent from the commander pages, versus Crimson Cowl 862/2281 and optimized 5/25. Spellbook 0 -> 0.
material_candidates.reason: Genuine swap 1: the deck is thin on spot creature removal and Crimson Cowl's Loki copy is blank, while every Ultimo copy is a repeatable each-opponent edict. Cut is not an owner card; the adoption counter-evidence and the curve cost are disclosed.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Two swaps: two Villains whose Loki copies do nothing or lose their attack triggers become two enters-trigger removal Villains whose copies edict each opponent or destroy a small creature on every Loki attack. Cost: curve moves up (MV3 18 -> 16, MV4 17 -> 18, MV6 4 -> 5; P(MV<=3 Villain by turn 3) 0.3005 -> 0.2567) and both adds have lower EDHREC adoption than the cuts. Game Changers stay at 5; lands stay at 34; Villain count stays at 29; Spellbook combos stay at 0. Neither cut is an owner addition or explicit keep.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: SELECTED research candidate (two genuine swaps). Each half is independent; each add also has a staged alternative cut (Ultimo over Kang Prime keeping Crimson Cowl; Elektra over Iron Monger keeping Killmonger).
Pass C three-card package (staged complete 100). NOT COUNTED: Strionic is rarely payable on attack turns and Boots adds whole Loki combats more often than Strionic adds copies.
Three-card enters-trigger package (staged complete 100). NOT COUNTED: Victor Timely is not clearly better than Kang Prime (53/2281 adoption, needs graveyard fuel).

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C requested Strionic Resonator against Swiftfoot Boots and Seize the Day against Black Market Connections; both are staged as complete 100s (Seize also against Urza's Incubator) and not counted. Ultimo is staged against Kang Prime and Elektra against Iron Monger, Sadistic Tycoon.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Two Villain slots (Crimson Cowl, Killmonger) have printed value that is wasted on Loki's token copies, which never 'attack' for trigger purposes, while the deck lacks repeatable creature removal; Loki copies of enters-trigger removal Villains fix both.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Two genuine swaps: +Ultimo, Civilization's End -Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil and +Elektra, Daughter of the Hand -Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper (rules-driven, moderate confidence, curve cost and adoption counter-evidence disclosed). Pass C's two requested swaps were tested and are not better. Every other challenger is dominated, owner-rejected, not a Villain, marginal or invalid. RESEARCH_ONLY.

withdrawal_reason: RESEARCH_ONLY: two genuine swaps (+Ultimo, Civilization's End -Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil; +Elektra, Daughter of the Hand -Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper), below the five-swap owner-presentation floor. Pass C's requested tests were run in bounded form: Strionic Resonator is staged but not better than Swiftfoot Boots, and Seize the Day is rejected against Black Market Connections and Urza's Incubator. Every other candidate is dominated (Tri-Sentinel), not clearly better than an incumbent (Victor Timely, Wily Tycoon; Kingpin, Wilson Fisk; Archnemesis; Terminate; Bedevil), marginal (Secluded Courtyard), owner-rejected (extra clone effects, Plans, generic tutors and combo), not a Villain (Hostage Taker), or invalid (unreleased Hela, Mistress of Darkness and Mirror Universe Intrusion; banned Dockside Extortionist and Jeweled Lotus). The five-swap floor is not met without padding. This packet is NOT owner-presentable and NOT owner approved; the canonical Loki, the Deceiver list is unchanged.
